_notes: Layer-1 suppression registry. Add an entry only after semantic review (Layer 2) and a rationale in LESSONS.md. deadcode uses exact relative paths; duplicates prefers stable cluster id and accepts a legacy path only when every cluster member matches it; hardcoded prefers candidate id and accepts exact (path, pattern) pairs; capabilities keys are 'path:qualname'; forks keys are 'path:qualname::path:qualname' with both sides sorted; contracts keys are file paths or 'path:lineno'. This registry ships empty: every project must build its own suppression list from its own semantic reviews.
